# Tennessee Titans

> Official home of the Tennessee Titans NFL franchise with news, tickets, schedules, and team information.

The Tennessee Titans are an NFL team based in Nashville, playing at Nissan Stadium. The site serves as the primary digital hub for team news, ticket sales, fan engagement, and information about the franchise's history from its Houston Oilers roots to the new stadium project opening in 2027.

## Key Topics

- Tennessee Titans
- NFL
- Nissan Stadium
- Nashville
- Free Agency

## Core Team Information

- [Titans Home](https://www.tennesseetitans.com): Tennessee Titans official homepage with news, tickets, and team updates
- [Titans News Home](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/news): Official Tennessee Titans news hub with team updates and roster moves
- [2025 Schedule](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/schedule/index): Tennessee Titans 2025 regular season and preseason schedule
- [Tickets](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/tickets): Tennessee Titans ticket sales for season, single game, and group plans
- [The Titans of Tennessee](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/brand): Tennessee Titans brand identity, history, and visual design evolution

## Stadium & Venue

- [Nissan Stadium](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/stadium/index): Nissan Stadium information and guide for Tennessee Titans home venue
- [The Stadium Project](https://www.tennesseetitans.com/new-stadium/index): New enclosed Nissan Stadium project along Cumberland River opening 2027
